operation_details.item: The user's portfolio site is built on a custom WordPress theme.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, I was just updating my portfolio site this morning. It's a bit of a ritual for me now.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Oh nice, you do that monthly, right? How's the current version looking?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, I try to refresh it every month. It's built on a custom WordPress theme I had made a while back, so it's easy to update on my own.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds practical. A custom theme gives you more control, I guess. How many pieces are you showing right now?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I've got twelve published clips up there. I usually swap out older ones for the fresher stuff.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Twelve solid pieces is a good number. Do you ever get inquiries through the site?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, I set up the contact form to link straight to my email, so it's pretty seamless when someone reaches out.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's smart. Keep it easy for clients, right? Sounds like your portfolio is in a good place.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the platform my portfolio is built on, while keeping the clips, update routine, and contact form details.
